title: CallBox::Share carries two bare bools (speaker, copied) edited by hand from set_share_speaker/mark_share_copied
trigger: Open Share Invite Link, copy, tick 'can speak'
effect: none today; 'copied' is a transient stage held as a bool that set_share_speaker resets by hand
fix: Share { link_kind: LinkKind, copied: Option<LinkKind> } or a small ShareStage enum so the 'copied' notice is tied to the link it copied

title: GroupCallScreen::composer_call and the composer's text are two things kept in step by hand
trigger: Type in the in-call composer, then the tracked call changes while the call window is closed
effect: none today: sync_group_call_composer clears the text on the next call-window frame; a closed window keeps the old text and the old composer_call until then
fix: hold the draft as Option<(CallId, text)> in CallView (replaced whole in sync_group_call_boxes) instead of a screen-wide composer entity plus a call stamp

title: SaveStage::Saving reads its failure from the bounded failure registry at every call, unlike Exiting which is settled into Refused
trigger: Save sends a toggle edit (signatures/auto-translate/history) that TDLib refuses; 64+ other refusals are recorded before the box next derives its state
effect: the registry forgets the refusal, state() returns Saved and the box closes as if saved, dropping the typed edits and the reason
fix: settle_group_edit_box converts a failed Saving request into SaveStage::Refused(reason) exactly as it already does for Exiting

title: StreamPhoto::Blurred { image: None } folds a failed blur into the loaded stage, so a failure is never asked again for the same path
trigger: Open a live stream window for a channel whose photo file cannot be read when it is first blurred (file mid-write)
effect: the blurred backdrop stays missing (initials/plain background) until the chat's photo path changes or the window reopens; group_call_stream_photo matches the cached path and returns the empty image
fix: StreamPhoto::Failed { path } as its own variant, retried on a later path or reopen, instead of Blurred with an Option image

title: send_group_call_join mutes the session's self-mute mark before the join is sent and does not put it back when the send fails
trigger: Push-to-talk on, press Join while the connection refuses the join (join_video_chat returns Err), then turn push-to-talk off
effect: the tracked call keeps is_muted_self = true from the failed attempt; the mute button shows muted before any join and the next join starts muted although push-to-talk is off
fix: set the mute mark only when join_video_chat returns Ok (or send it as part of the join request) so a refused join changes nothing
